global::Engine.GameInit.doc: Once, right after the game-init hook. Delivered immediately.

global::Engine.SceneLoading.doc: Before a scene is created, after the pre-load hook. Delivered immediately.

global::Engine.SceneLoaded.doc: First frame of a scene, after every onReady.

global::Engine.SceneUnloading.doc: Before the scene is deleted. Delivered immediately.

global::Engine.SceneUnloaded.doc: After the scene was deleted. Delivered immediately; the scene no longer exists.

global::Engine.ResetPressed.doc: The N64 reset button. About half a second is left before the console resets.

global::Engine.PakInserted.doc: A Rumble, Controller or Transfer Pak was inserted.

scene::Loaded.doc: First frame of the current scene, after every onReady.

scene::Unloading.doc: Before the current scene is deleted. Delivered immediately.

prefab::Spawned.doc: Heard inside each prefab instance on its first frame, after every onReady of its objects.

prefab::Destroying.doc: Heard inside a prefab instance when removal of its root was requested.

prefab::Enabled.doc: Heard inside a prefab instance when its root became active.

prefab::Disabled.doc: Heard inside a prefab instance when its root became inactive.
